name: Murici (Brazil)
description: Divided diagonally green and white by a white band rising to the fly, charged at the centre with a blue disc bearing the name MURICI and a ring of yellow stars, flanked by a sugar-cane plant and a coconut palm.
history: Murici is a municipality in the state of Alagoas, Brazil.

features.role: disc bearing the name MURICI with a white band and yellow stars
sugar cane and coconut palm flanking the disc
